name: Argona
text:
HOLY SH*T. i made my first $10,000 with Grok Bot. THANKS ELON

for months i kept asking myself one thing: how do i build income that runs without me

so i sat down with Grok Bot and we went through dozens of ways to make money

most of them needed clients, time or luck

title: 用 Grok Bot 赚到第一个 $10,000
summary: 标题党式的赚钱帖：作者称和 Grok Bot 一起梳理了几十种赚钱方法，想找到不依赖客户、时间和运气的被动收入，并声称已赚到第一个 1 万美元。抓到的正文在开头就截断了，没有具体方法，信息量低，更像引流推广。
